name: flow-format
description: Explain how a flow, a procedure, a chain of steps, or a workflow goes as numbered steps, each one action sentence and a short unindented paragraph of details, with a plain-text diagram after them when the flow branches or loops

interface.shortDescription: Explain a flow step by step
interface.longDescription: Answers a question about how something proceeds from start to end, such as a release process, a setup, or how a change gets from an issue to the main branch. Each step is one action sentence that starts with a verb, then a blank line, then an unindented paragraph of one to three sentences on what the step does, what it makes, and what it depends on. When the flow branches or loops, a plain-text diagram of boxes and arrows follows the steps. The answer is in the language you write in. Mermaid goes only into a file you asked for, never into the chat answer. It is one instruction file and runs nothing.
defaultPrompt: Explain how a change goes from an issue to a merge
